title: Stdio Artifacts and Io
description: Replace ad-hoc MediaFormat IO with a zero-app stdio plugin whose artifacts are the well-known file types. Absorb dsl/pack/op/spr/diff/mutations into nested schema/{snapshot,diff,mutations}/{text,binary}. Add required builder and decomposer facets. Rewrite import/export as artifact-to-artifact serializers/deserializers. Hand-roll all codecs to real fidelity. Enforce via taxonomy twins and seven new policy rules.
summary: Delivered zero-app stdio plugin (29 artifacts), nested schema text/binary, builder/decomposer, 285 curated IO pairs, seven policy rules + launch gates, host/mimes rewire across W0–W7. W8 aggregate: cargo test -p semio-s-plugin-stdio 71/71; spot cargo check green; launch.json fresh; stdio policy rules 0/0/0/249/0/0/0 (schema-representation remainder on plugin trees only); plugin-registry check crash fixed, remaining findings documented. Closed locally (repo MCP unavailable). Post-close: filled 249 missing mutations schemaFormats leaves (graphql/json/proto) → schema-representation 0.
